subject.title: fix(channels): progress drafts only for long tasks, with the model's own preamble as the status headline

question: Should the three optional progress-lifecycle fields on GetReplyOptions become the supported Plugin SDK contract for channel-owned narration and preamble headlines?
rationale: The fields are additive and mechanically validated, but choosing this public lifecycle seam affects third-party plugins and cannot be settled by tests or visual proof alone.

options.title: Accept the narrow lifecycle seam
options.body: Keep the three optional fields, document their lifecycle semantics, and merge after exact-head proof and checks refresh.

options.title: Keep the seam internal
options.body: Move the lifecycle wiring behind an internal runtime contract and avoid expanding the public Plugin SDK in this PR.

options.title: Split the feature
options.body: Land only the time-gate repair and revisit cross-channel preamble headlines with a separately designed SDK contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow lifecycle seam
recommendation.body: Keep the three optional fields, document their lifecycle semantics, and merge after exact-head proof and checks refresh.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership and the feature history place the cross-channel product and SDK-boundary decision with steipete.
